transcript.text: Men, 80% of your visible facial aging can actually come from the sun.
This is the Fitzpatrick scale. It shows how easily a skin type burns and tans, and most Indians are type 4 and 5.
So you tend to burn less, but age and pigment more easily, which means a sunscreen can be the most effective anti-ageing product you can own.
And here's how you should pick one. First, SPF.

Most of us buy sunscreen by looking at SPF, but it's not really the most important thing. It protects you from UVB, which is responsible for sunburn. But Indians don't really sunburn easily, so a range of 30 to 50 SPF is honestly enough.

PA on the other hand is actually more important. It protects you from UVA rays, which penetrates deeper into the skin and is responsible for premature ageing. The more plus signs next to PA, the stronger the protection. So look for PA++++.
If you have oily skin, go for a lightweight gel, fluid or matte sunscreen. If you have dry skin, go for a moisturising option. And if you sweat heavily, look for water resistance.
